lines.en: label tsubasaspecial20:
I tap on Tsubasa’s name in my phone with a bit more optimism than normal- but it’s not because I understand her any better now.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Tsubasa 的名字,带着比平常多一点乐观——但这不是因为我更理解她了。

lines.en: And it’s also not because I foresee any sort of progression in regard to our (but mostly her) super secret plan to relocate a gyaru.
lines.zh: 也不是因为我预见,我们(主要是她)那项「转移一个辣妹」的最高机密计划会有任何进展。

lines.en: That still hinges upon me to some extent and, with no further movement from Chika on top of my customary lack of action, things will likely stay the same for at least a little while longer.
lines.zh: 那在某种程度上仍取决于我,而 Chika 毫无新动静、我又习惯性按兵不动,事情多半还会原样再僵上一阵。

lines.en: But as these last few sentences have pulled me from the beaten path we were walking together just moments ago, I’d like to now confess why I’ve been stricken with optimism.
lines.zh: 但既然刚才这几句话已把我们从方才并肩走过的老路上拽开,我想坦白:为什么我被乐观击中了。

lines.en: scene noonsky
You see, last night, I had another dream — and in it, the paint peeled from off of the walls in my home, but it was only the first layer.
lines.zh: 你看,昨晚我又做了一个梦——梦里,我家墙上的漆剥落下来,但那只是第一层。

lines.en: The layer beneath told me a secret.
lines.zh: 底下的那一层,告诉我一个秘密。

lines.en: It said “The past will catch up to me” before that layer peeled off as well.
lines.zh: 它说「过去会追上我」,然后那一层也剥落了。

lines.en: Then suddenly, my house was gone and I was all alone in a field full of sunflowers.
lines.zh: 然后忽然间,房子没了,我孤身一人站在一片向日葵田里。

lines.en: I plucked one from the ground and pressed it to my tongue.
lines.zh: 我从地里摘下一朵,贴在舌头上。

lines.en: And I remembered why I’ve always loved them.
lines.zh: 然后我想起自己为什么一直喜欢它们。

lines.en: : Ahh, Arakawa-Sensei. Excellent timing. I was just about to call you.
lines.zh: : 啊哈,Arakawa 老师。来得正好。我正要打给你。

lines.en: : Really? You never call me.
lines.zh: : 真的?你从来不给我打电话。

lines.en: : Well, today is a special exception as you are being cordially invited to join me in my office for a bit of a meeting.
lines.zh: : 嗯,今天是个特别的例外——你正被诚挚邀请来我的办公室,开一个小会。

lines.en: : Does this involve Chika again? Because I still haven’t-
lines.zh: : 这又和 Chika 有关吗?因为我还没——

lines.en: : It does not. This is a matter regarding my family and yours.
lines.zh: : 无关。这是关于我家和你家的事。

lines.en: : If this is a joint marriage proposal, I’d like to remind you I have basically nothing to offer.
lines.zh: : 如果这是一份联姻提案,我想提醒你,我基本一无所有。

lines.en: : Why, that’s not true at all. But you can take solace in the fact that it’s something completely different.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,那可完全不是实话。不过你可以安心——这件事完全是另一回事。

lines.en: : Can...you tell me what that something is?
lines.zh: : 能……能告诉我那是什么吗?

lines.en: : I will! But I would like you to actually be here first.
lines.zh: : 我会说!但我想请你本人先到场。

lines.en: : I guess I’ll...start walking then.
lines.zh: : 那我猜……我这就出发?

lines.en: : Oh, that won’t be necessary. Someone should-
lines.zh: : 哦,不必。应该已经有人——

lines.en: : Arakawa-sama, please get into the vehicle.
lines.zh: : Arakawa 殿下,请上车。

lines.en: : What the fuck? Where did you come from?
lines.zh: : 什么鬼?你从哪冒出来的?

lines.en: : Oh, splendid! It sounds as if your car has already arrived!
lines.zh: : 哦,好极了!听起来你的车已经到了!

lines.en: : You’ll be escorted directly to me upon arrival. I’m looking forward to it.
lines.zh: : 你一到就会有人直接送你来见我。我很期待。

lines.en: : Arakawa-sama, the mistress is waiting. Please get into the vehicle.
lines.zh: : Arakawa 殿下,夫人在等您。请上车。

lines.en: : Fine, okay. But I’m not wearing another blindfold.
lines.zh: : 行,好吧。但我不会再戴眼罩了。

lines.en: scene black
I get into the back of the car and am quickly whisked off to Tsukioka Manor for an impromptu meeting with someone I am now tempted to refer to as “the mistress.”
lines.zh: 我坐进轿车后座,被飞快地送往 Tsukioka 公馆,与一位我如今很想称之为「女主人」的人开一场临时会议。

lines.en: The main problem here is that I’d likely be unable to say this without a sarcastic undertone that would make it sound as if I’m mocking her. And I would prefer not being assassinated today.
lines.zh: 这里的主要问题是,我要这么说,多半免不了带上一股讽刺的底味,听起来像在嘲弄她。而我宁愿今天不被暗杀。

lines.en: As such, I will respect Tsubasa as much as I possibly can.
lines.zh: 因此,我会尽可能尊重 Tsubasa。

lines.en: And I will only try to have sex with her if I think she really wants it.
lines.zh: 而只有在我觉得她真心想要时,我才会试着和她上床。

lines.en: Anything else is just too risky.
lines.zh: 其余一切风险都太高。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting1
: Welcome to yet another brand new room — and a rare one at that. You join the ranks of the lucky few who have been able to sit with me at this table. It’s something you should be very proud of.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到又一个全新房间——而且相当罕见。你加入了有幸与我在此同桌的少数幸运儿之列。这值得你非常骄傲。

lines.en: : And all I had to do to get here was make your daughter want to bone me.
lines.zh: : 而我为了坐到这里所需要做的,只是让你女儿想和我上床。

lines.en: : My bad. I’m not very good at formal meetings like this.
lines.zh: : 我的错。我不太擅长这种正式会面。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting2
: It’s fine. It’s not as if anyone is listening in on us. I just can’t help but be taken aback by your...casual brazenness.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正没人在偷听。只是你那种……随口放肆,还是让我不由一怔。

lines.en: : No one’s ever had the courage to say such a thing to my face before.
lines.zh: : 从前从来没有人有勇气当着我的面说这种话。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting3
: But that’s just one more thing that makes you all the more interesting.
lines.zh: : 但这不过又是一件让你更有意思的事。

lines.en: : Am I allowed to flirt back or does that go against manor policy?
lines.zh: : 我可以回撩吗?还是这违反公馆规定?

lines.en: : Go ahead. This isn’t me accepting your advances, but I’m curious to see what you’d say.
lines.zh: : 请便。这不代表我接受你的殷勤,但我好奇你会说什么。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Nothing? Are you not attracted to me after all?
lines.zh: : 没有了?原来你终究不被我吸引?

lines.en: : It’s just...kind of hard when you’re directly challenging me.
lines.zh: : 只是……你正面将军的时候,有点难开口。

lines.en: : Then let’s just say you said something flattering and that I laughed. And that we left it at that before moving onto other things.
lines.zh: : 那就当你说了一句恭维话、我笑了。然后我们把它留在那里,继续谈别的。

lines.en: : Ahh, so it’s not just a meeting where you flirt with me. I was beginning to think the arranged marriage was for us.
lines.zh: : 啊哈,所以这不只是一场你撩我的会面。我开始以为这场联姻是给我们俩安排的了。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting4
: Oh, look! You managed to flirt after all. That was actually rather cute. Good job, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哦,看!你终究还是撩到了。其实相当可爱。干得好,Sensei。

lines.en: : And now it’s weird again since you’re complimenting me.
lines.zh: : 现在又怪起来了,因为你在夸我。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting5
: Does this feel awkward for you? Would we have been better off in the garden?
lines.zh: : 这让你觉得尴尬吗?我们在花园里是不是会好一些?

lines.en: : I know it might seem as if I’m trying to put myself in a position of power here, but the truth is I just had a lot of work to get done and all of that work is in here.
lines.zh: : 我知道这看起来像我在摆出上位者的姿态,但说实话,我只是有一堆工作要办,而那些工作全在这里。

lines.en: : It does...but it would feel less awkward if you’d just tell me why I’m here already.
lines.zh: : 是有点……但你要是直接告诉我我为什么在这里,就不那么尴尬了。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting6
: Then, to save both of us the discomfort, I’ll get right to it.
lines.zh: : 那么,为了免得我们俩都不自在,我直说了。

lines.en: : When we last left off on the stairs of your school’s archery range, you made it apparent that you weren’t interested in divulging any of your...personal details to me.
lines.zh: : 上次我们在你们学校弓道场的台阶上分别时,你明确表示,不打算向我透露任何……个人细节。

lines.en: : To which I responded that I would look into them on my own.
lines.zh: : 而我当时回应说,我会自己去查。

lines.en: : And...I’m assuming this meeting is in response to you doing just that.
lines.zh: : 而……我猜,这场会面正是你查完之后的产物。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting7
: And in that assumption, you would be correct...Akira.
lines.zh: : 在这个假设上,你是对的……Akira。

lines.en: Welp, make it four people who now know that name.
lines.zh: 好嘛,知道这个名字的人如今凑成四个了。

lines.en: : Is it okay if I call you that? It seems only fair, what with me just being “Tsubasa” to you and all.
lines.zh: : 我可以这么叫你吗?这看起来才公平——毕竟对你来说,我只是「Tsubasa」。

lines.en: : Is “the mistress” preferable? Because that’s how the driver earlier referred to you and I was thinking it might be fun to try that.
lines.zh: : 「女主人」不是更合意吗?因为刚才司机就是这么称呼你的,我想试试会不会很有趣。

lines.en: : If you’re planning on working for me instead of with me, such a title would be fine. But I’d prefer to keep things a bit more amiable between us.
lines.zh: : 如果你打算为我工作,而不是与我共事,那种头衔倒也无妨。但我更希望我们之间保持一些友好。

lines.en: : So...what do you want?
lines.zh: : 那么……你想要什么?

lines.en: : Why do you think I want something?
lines.zh: : 你为什么觉得我想要什么?

lines.en: : The look into my background...the raised eyebrow...the way your hands are folded together...all signs point to you wanting something.
lines.zh: : 查我的背景……挑起的眉毛……你交叠的双手……一切迹象都指向你有所图。

lines.en: : What did you find out? Why did it warrant calling me to your home?
lines.zh: : 你查到了什么?为什么值得把我叫到你家?

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting8
: What I found out is that you’re a much more...legitimate teacher than you present yourself to be.
lines.zh: : 我查到的是,你比你表现出来的要……正统得多的一位老师。

lines.en: : Your grades in school were exceptional...among the top of your class even. And every single career assessment survey you ever filled out all had the same exact aspiration listed on them. Teacher.
lines.zh: : 你在学校的成绩出类拔萃……甚至在班里名列前茅。而你填过的每一份职业测评,上面写的志向全都一模一样。教师。

lines.en: : You read my...career assessment surveys?
lines.zh: : 你看了我的……职业测评?

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting1
: If it’s something you’ve written on paper and handed over to someone, chances are I have access to it.
lines.zh: : 只要是你写在纸上、交到别人手里的东西,我多半都拿得到。

lines.en: : You were quite the poet as well. Do you still write?
lines.zh: : 你当年还是个诗人。还写吗?

lines.en: : Ara- Ahem...Akira-san?
lines.zh: : 啊——咳嗯……Akira 桑?

lines.en: : No. I don’t write anymore.
lines.zh: : 不写了。我不再写了。

lines.en: : Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 出过什么事吗?

lines.en: : Is that a troubling question?
lines.zh: : 这个问题很棘手?

lines.en: : I don’t want to talk about it.
lines.zh: : 我不想谈。

lines.en: : So much for not being very interesting.
lines.zh: : 「你不怎么有趣」就到这了啊。

lines.en: : Is that all, mistress?
lines.zh: : 都问完了,女主人?

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting9
: Oh my. I didn’t mean to anger you. I was simply curious about how you became the way you are today.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我没想惹你生气。我只是好奇,你是怎么变成今天的你的。

lines.en: : No amount of records or poetry can properly retell the story of the life you’ve lived. So I was hoping you would share a piece or two of that with me.
lines.zh: : 再多的档案、再多的诗,都讲不好你走过的人生。所以我曾希望你能分我一两片。

lines.en: : And I was hoping my private life would stay a little more, you know, private.
lines.zh: : 而我曾希望我的私生活能更……你懂的,私密一点。

lines.en: : In my defense, you didn’t try to stop me when I explicitly told you this was coming. I’d not have pried if I’d only known you were against it.
lines.zh: : 请容我辩解一句:我明确告诉你这一天会来的时候,你并没有阻止我。若早知道你反对,我不会去翻的。

lines.en: : It’s...fine.
lines.zh: : 那……好吧。

lines.en: : To be honest, the past is a bit of a touchy subject for me as there’s still a lot of it I don’t remember.
lines.zh: : 说实话,过去对我来说是个有点碰不得的话题——因为其中很大一部分,我都不记得了。

lines.en: : That you don’t...remember?
lines.zh: : 你不……记得?

lines.en: : Just call it amnesia. That’s the simplest way to explain it.
lines.zh: : 就叫它失忆吧。这是最简单的解释。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting10
: Your medical records mention nothing about amnesia. Could I be missing documents? I’m normally so good at this.
lines.zh: : 你的病历里可一个字都没提失忆。是我漏了什么文件吗?我平时很擅长这种事。

lines.en: : It’s not something that would be documented. And yeah, there was a thing that happened.
lines.zh: : 那不是会被记录在案的东西。而且,确实发生过一件事。

lines.en: : But I’m nowhere even close to being able to talk about it with anyone yet...let alone someone who’s only probing me to satisfy her own curiosity.
lines.zh: : 但我还远没到能和任何人谈它的地步……更别说一个只为满足自己好奇心的盘问者。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting11
: You say that as if I don’t care about you. That hurts.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像我不在乎你似的。这伤到我了。

lines.en: : Do you, though?
lines.zh: : 你在乎吗?

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : But it’s only because of the role I play in your scheme, right? It’s only because Touka needs me in order to...move forward and adhere to the plan you have for her or whatever.
lines.zh: : 但那只是因为我在你的棋局里扮演着角色,对吧?只是因为 Touka 需要我,才能……向前走、执行你为她铺排的计划什么的。

lines.en: : Am I wrong?
lines.zh: : 我说错了?

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting12
: Hah...
: I sincerely apologize, Akira-san.
lines.zh: : 我真诚地道歉,Akira 桑。

lines.en: : I must have let my guard down at the archery range as it’s very clear now that I didn’t properly think my words through.
lines.zh: : 我一定是在弓道场放松了警惕——现在很清楚,我当时没有把话想清楚。

lines.en: : If I had, you wouldn’t think this way at all.
lines.zh: : 如果想清楚了,你根本不会有这种想法。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting13
: It’s true that I fancy pulling the strings...and that there is nothing more important to me than ensuring my daughters’ futures play out just as smoothly as mine.
lines.zh: : 不错,我确实喜欢牵线……也确实没有什么比确保女儿们的未来走得和我一样顺遂更重要。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean I see you as nothing more than a hunk of meat...ready to be thrown on the grill so they can go to sleep sated and satisfied.
lines.zh: : 但这不代表我把你只看作一块肉……一块随时可以丢上烤架、好让她们心满意足睡去的肉。

lines.en: : I see you as an equal.
lines.zh: : 我把你看作对等的人。

lines.en: : You don’t see anyone as an equal.
lines.zh: : 你没把任何人看作对等的人。

lines.en: : That is simply not true. And if I’ve come across that way, it means I must have improperly conveyed other words of mine as well.
lines.zh: : 绝非如此。如果我给过你那种印象,那说明我一定也错误传达了自己的其他话。

lines.en: : Consistent poor-wording aside...what does that have to do with our families? What was so important that you went out of your way to borderline kidnap me?
lines.zh: : 撇开一贯的词不达意不谈……那和我们的家族有什么关系?什么事重要到你要变着法地近似绑架我?

lines.en: : I would like to ask you for a favor.
lines.zh: : 我想请你帮个忙。

lines.en: : Big surprise. Who do you want me to reel in now?
lines.zh: : 大惊喜。这次要我去钓谁?

lines.en: : My daughter.
lines.zh: : 我的女儿。

lines.en: : Touka’s too perceptive to-
lines.zh: : Touka 太敏锐,她不会——

lines.en: : My other daughter.
lines.zh: : 我另一个女儿。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene tsubasameeting14
: Tsukasa-darling! Could you come in here?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 亲爱的!能进来一下吗?

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting15
: Yes, Mother?
lines.zh: : 怎么了,母亲?

lines.en: : Tsukasa, how are you faring in your studies?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,你的学业进行得如何?

lines.en: : Exceptionally, Mother. There are no problems at all.
lines.zh: : 出类拔萃,母亲。毫无问题。

lines.en: : But are you enjoying yourself?
lines.zh: : 可你过得开心吗?

lines.en: : Yes, Mother.
lines.zh: : 开心,母亲。

lines.en: : It’s okay to be honest right now, dear. This isn’t a formal meeting.
lines.zh: : 现在可以说实话,亲爱的。这不是正式会面。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting16
: But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting17
: Oh. It’s just Jeeves. What is he doing here?
lines.zh: : 哦,只是 Jeeves。他来这里干什么?

lines.en: : Tsukasa, how would you feel about Arakawa-sensei taking over your lessons?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,让 Arakawa 老师接管你的课业,你觉得怎么样?

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting18
: Really?! Can he?! That’s okay?!
lines.zh: : 真的吗?!他可以吗?!可以吗?!

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Is there a problem, Arakawa-sensei? It’s not as if you don’t already have experience tutoring girls her age, correct?
lines.zh: : 有什么问题吗,Arakawa 老师?给这个年纪的女孩做辅导,你又不少经验,不是吗?

lines.en: scene imissyou12
scene tsubasameeting18
: Tsukasa is on another level. I can’t keep up with whatever she’s being taught right now.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 在另一个层次。她现在被教的东西,我跟不上。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting19
: The same goes for Touka and she’s been exceptional under your guidance. I assume you’ll have no trouble replicating that same success with someone younger.
lines.zh: : Touka 也一样,而她在你的指导下出类拔萃。我猜,在更年轻的人身上复制这份成功,你毫不费力。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Jeeves! If I’m too smart for you to tutor, I’ll just teach you instead! It’ll be fun!
lines.zh: : 别担心,Jeeves!要是我聪明得让你教不了,那我反过来教你!会很好玩的!

lines.en: : I don’t have the time to come here every day, Tsubasa. I’m already teaching at school and there’s no way they’d admit Tsukasa at her age.
lines.zh: : 我没有时间每天来这里,Tsubasa。我本来就在学校教书,而且凭 Tsukasa 的年纪,他们也不可能收她。

lines.en: : The school will do whatever I tell them to. But that’s not what I had in mind.
lines.zh: : 学校会照我说的办。但那不是我的打算。

lines.en: : Then what-
lines.zh: : 那是什么——

lines.en: : I was planning on having my daughters move into your new building as well.
lines.zh: : 我还计划让我的女儿们搬进你的新楼。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting20
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Is something wrong, dear?
lines.zh: : 怎么了,亲爱的?

lines.en: : I’m...going to live with Onee-sama?
lines.zh: : 我……要和 Onee-sama 住在一起?

lines.en: : There are some preparations that still need to be made. But that is the plan as of right now, yes.
lines.zh: : 还有一些准备要做。但就目前而言,计划确实如此。

lines.en: : And...what...what did Onee-sama say?
lines.zh: : 而……什么……Onee-sama 怎么说?

lines.en: : That she’ll uphold her duty as the heir to the foundation and do exactly as I ask. Just as I expect you to do as well.
lines.zh: : 她说,她会恪守财团继承人的职责,完全照我说的做。正如我也期待你这样做。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting21
: But...that means I’ll spend even less time with you and Papa than I do now! And I barely ever get to spend time with you in the first place!
lines.zh: : 可是……那样的话,我和你、和 Papa 相处的时间就更少了!而我现在本来就几乎没时间和你们相处!

lines.en: : What are you saying, dear? You’re with me almost every waking hour of the day.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么,亲爱的?你醒着的每一刻几乎都和我在一起。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting22
: That’s not what I mean! You’re always working and Papa never wants to see me and I’m tired of you always trying to get rid of me! I didn’t do anything wrong!
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思!你永远在工作,Papa 从来不想见我,我烦透了你们总想把我支走!我又没做错什么!

lines.en: : Tsukasa?...
lines.zh: : Tsukasa?……

lines.en: : I want to stay here with you! I don’t want to leave yet!
lines.zh: : 我想留在这里陪你!我还不想走!

lines.en: : Tsu-
lines.zh: : Tsu——

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting23
: I’m going to my room!
lines.zh: : 我回房间了!

lines.en: : Tsukasa! Wait!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa!等等!

lines.en: : You know, if I knew that’s what you were ramping up to, I probably could have prevented this.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,我要是早知道你在铺垫这个,也许能阻止这一切。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting24
: What? How? I don’t even understand what just happened.
lines.zh: : 什么?怎么阻止?我连刚才发生了什么都不明白。

lines.en: : She’s lonely. I’ve known that since National Tsukasa Day.
lines.zh: : 她孤独。从「全国 Tsukasa 日」那天起我就知道。

lines.en: : How is she lonely? She’s surrounded by either attendants or me for nearly twenty-four hours every day. She gets everything she wants and does everything she wants. How is that lonely?
lines.zh: : 她怎么会孤独?每天差不多二十四小时,她的身边不是侍从就是我。她想要什么就有什么,想做什么就做什么。那怎么叫孤独?

lines.en: : All of that might be true, but when was the last time the two of you did something fun together? Where you weren’t just being dragged along as a babysitter.
lines.zh: : 这些也许都是真的。可你们俩上一次一起做点好玩的事,是什么时候?那种你不是被拖着、充当保姆的时候。

lines.en: : I’m not...
lines.zh: : 我不是……

lines.en: : It’s the same with Touka too, but to a much lesser extent since you still make time to drop by her dorm room every now and then.
lines.zh: : Touka 也一样,只是程度轻得多——毕竟你还会时不时抽空去她宿舍坐坐。

lines.en: : Plus she’s also mature enough to shelve those feelings and hide them from you. Tsukasa can’t do that.
lines.zh: : 再说她已经成熟到可以把那些感情收起来、不让你看见。Tsukasa 做不到。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting25
: Hah...
: You’re right...
lines.zh: : 你说得对……

lines.en: : You’re absolutely right.
lines.zh: : 你说得完全正确。

lines.en: : I don’t know how I didn’t realize that earlier.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己怎么没早点意识到。

lines.en: : Just...too busy focusing on other things, I guess.
lines.zh: : 只是……忙着盯着别的东西了吧,我猜。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting26
: All other things are now on hold — and that includes this meeting. It’s clear that I need to have a talk with both of my daughters.
lines.zh: : 其他一切现在都暂停——包括这场会面。显然,我需要和我的两个女儿各谈一谈。

lines.en: : Does that mean I can stop teaching Touka things? She keeps trying to learn while she’s in school and I’m not sure how to handle it.
lines.zh: : 那是不是意味着我可以不用教 Touka 了?她在学校总想学,我都不知道怎么办。

lines.en: : You’ll continue on with Touka exactly as you’ve done thus far. And Tsukasa will follow shortly after things are remedied between the two of us.
lines.zh: : Touka 那边照旧,和至今为止一样。等我们母女之间的疙瘩解开,Tsukasa 也会很快跟上。

lines.en: : Why do you even want me to teach her? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么要我教她?我不明白。

lines.en: : You don’t need to.
lines.zh: : 你不需要明白。

lines.en: scene black
Tsubasa stands up from her desk, prompting me to do the same as I’m sure I’ll be escorted out of the manor momentarily.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 从办公桌后起身,示意我也起身——我确信,自己马上就会被送出公馆。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting27
I get that her methods in growing her daughters can be a little...unorthodox, but sending a girl Tsukasa’s age to live in the same building as me is something I didn’t even think she’d consider.
lines.zh: 我理解她培养女儿的手段可以有点……非正统,但让一个 Tsukasa 这个年纪的女孩搬进和我同一栋楼,是我从没想过她会考虑的事。

lines.en: I mean...why would she? Chika makes sense. Touka kind of makes sense...But what could Tsukasa gain from that?
lines.zh: 就是说……她为什么会那么做?Chika 说得通。Touka 勉强说得通……可 Tsukasa 能从那里得到什么?

lines.en: Is it the risk that would help her grow?
lines.zh: : 是那份风险能帮她成长吗?

lines.en: Have I fallen so far that there’s any risk at all?
lines.zh: : 我已经堕落到多少还存有风险了吗?

lines.en: I just don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 我只是不明白。

lines.en: : That look on your face tells me I should clarify something.
lines.zh: : 你脸上的表情告诉我,我该澄清一些事。

lines.en: : Why were you...sending her to live with me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么……要送她来和我住?

lines.en: : It was just the same building. It’s not as if I was asking her to sleep in your bed.
lines.zh: : 只是同一栋楼而已。又不是让她睡你的床。

lines.en: : Besides, when I was her age, I had an apartment as well. I just never had any use for it.
lines.zh: : 再说,我在她这个年纪,也有一套自己的公寓。只是我从没用过。

lines.en: : And she does?
lines.zh: : 而她会用?

lines.en: : I thought so. But that was before the screaming and the revelation of her loneliness. Now, I know I was wrong. That happens sometimes, you know.
lines.zh: : 我原以为会。但那是在尖叫、和她孤独的真相暴露之前。现在我知道我错了。这种事时有发生,你知道吗。

lines.en: : Just because I’m powerful doesn’t mean I don’t make mistakes. I’m as flawed and vulnerable as everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我有权有势,不代表我不犯错。我和所有人一样有缺陷、一样脆弱。

lines.en: : I’m the same as you.
lines.zh: : 我和你一样。

lines.en: : That’s what I meant by equal.
lines.zh: : 这就是我说的「对等」。

lines.en: : And, Akira-sensei...
lines.zh: : 还有,Akira 老师……

lines.en: : I’m not trying to insinuate anything here...but my decision to send her to Touka’s new apartment complex was not for the reasons you may think.
lines.zh: : 我不是在影射什么……但我把她送去 Touka 新公寓楼的决定,并不是你以为的那个理由。

lines.en: : And...what do you assume I thought?
lines.zh: : 那……你以为我以为的是什么?

lines.en: : Let’s just say that there are different stages of development my daughters need to go through before I will fully acknowledge them as women.
lines.zh: : 可以这么说:在我的女儿们被完全承认为女人之前,需要经历不同的成长阶段。

lines.en: : Touka is in the final phase of development...and I trust that she’s mature enough to make decisions in regard to how and when she uses her body.
lines.zh: : Touka 处于成长的最终阶段……而我信任她足够成熟,可以就如何、何时使用她的身体做出决定。

lines.en: : You could lay as many fingers as you want on her and I’d think nothing of it.
lines.zh: : 你想在她身上放几根手指都可以,我不会多想。

lines.en: : But if you believe for even a moment that I’d apply that same ideology to Tsukasa...we’d have a bit of a problem on our hands.
lines.zh: : 可你要是有一瞬间以为,我会把同样的理念套在 Tsukasa 身上……我们之间就要有点麻烦了。

lines.en: : I would like to avoid that. Wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 我想避免那种麻烦。你不想吗?

lines.en: : Definitely. I wouldn’t have even thought about that.
lines.zh: : 绝对想。我连想都不会往那方面想。

lines.en: : Are you telling me you don’t find Tsukasa pretty?
lines.zh: : 你是在告诉我,你不觉得 Tsukasa 漂亮?

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting28
: Just a joke to lighten the mood. There was no right answer there.
lines.zh: : 开个玩笑缓和气氛而已。那个问题没有正确答案。

lines.en: : Plus, once Chika moves in, I doubt you’ll have time to even think of doing such things with other girls.
lines.zh: : 再说,等 Chika 搬进来,我怀疑你连想对其他女孩做那种事的功夫都没有。

lines.en: scene tsubasameeting29
: But in the event that both she and my oldest daughter can not satisfy your...urges...
lines.zh: : 不过,万一她和我的大女儿都无法满足你的……欲望……

lines.en: : All you need to do is let me know and...arrangements can be made.
lines.zh: : 你只需让我知道,然后……可以安排。

lines.en: : That...was a joke too, right?
lines.zh: : 那……也是玩笑,对吧?

lines.en: : I wonder.
lines.zh: : 我想想。

lines.en: scene black
I exit the manor both terrified and aroused.
lines.zh: 我走出公馆,既惊恐又兴奋。

lines.en: And after spending a lot more time with her recently, I think that’s...just the sort of effect Tsubasa is going to have on me.
lines.zh: 在最近和她相处了这么多之后,我想,这……就是 Tsubasa 会对我产生的效果。

lines.en: I understand her, but I don’t.
lines.zh: 我理解她,又不理解。

lines.en: I’m afraid of her, but I’m not.
lines.zh: 我怕她,又不怕。

lines.en: I can’t explain it.
lines.zh: 我解释不了。

lines.en: But there is one thing I know for sure.
lines.zh: 但有一件事我确信无疑。

lines.en: And it’s that I need to keep her close.
lines.zh: 那就是,我必须让她待在我够得着的地方。

lines.en: Because I know that if I don’t, I’ll be peering over my shoulder for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: 因为我知道,如果不这样,我的余生都得回头张望。

lines.en: : What the fuck are arrangements?
lines.zh: : 「可以安排」到底是什么鬼?

lines.en: $ tsubasaspecial20 = True
$ tsubasa_love += 1
Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
